title: Sources: Visa is in late-stage talks to buy stablecoin custody and infrastructure provider Fireblocks for ~$2.5B, its first acquisition in the stablecoin sector (Lucinda Shen/Axios)
summary: Lucinda Shen / Axios: Sources: Visa is in late-stage talks to buy stablecoin custody and infrastructure provider Fireblocks for ~$2.5B, its first acquisition in the stablecoin sector — Visa is in late stage talks to acquire stablecoin infrastructure and custody company Fireblocks for about $2.5 billion, Axios Pro has learned from multiple sources.
